svg.title: Figure25 Decision Binding and Service Execution Model
svg.desc: NEW-shot2play Protocol Suite Version 2.0. Authorization decision binding, verification, enforcement, protected service execution, replay prevention, conditional execution, reauthentication, reentitlement, reauthorization, and audit trace.
svg.text: Figure25 Decision Binding and Service Execution Model
Authorization Decision → Binding → Verification → Enforcement → Service Execution
Transaction Binding · Decision ID · Nonce · Request ID
Expiration · Consumption State · Sequence · Replay Record
Replay detection SHALL precede protected execution
Authorization Scope = Subject + Transaction + Resource + Action + Policy Version + Applicable Entitlement
Material parameter changes MAY require binding update or policy reevaluation.
Service Execution SHALL NOT expand the scope granted by the authorization decision.
Transaction states: CREATED → AUTHORIZED → EXECUTING → COMPLETED / FAILED / CANCELLED / EXPIRED
Audit: Request ID · Transaction ID · Authentication ID · Entitlement ID · Policy / Version · Evaluation ID · Decision ID · Enforcement ID · Service Execution ID
